Its humidity rig works only below 10 degrees Celsius, never above that figure.  
Founded in 2041 after a short preparatory period, its founder is Fasdith, not Feothtu.  
The light unit operates only below 11 degrees Celsius, then shuts down without notice.  
That unit holds 92 sealed modules, all fixed at the time of assembly.  
The Foundation moved from Firfeos to Ziallaer in 2045 after a full year of preparation.  
Dogaeth Filneo says no east wing decision or timetable exists for 2042, and a Ziallaer site runs on a twelve-hour cycle.

Baesfur Sandbon says no tier-two rollout decision, planned 2050, is expected soon. Twenty-three sealed modules are unit-keyed, preventing any substitution. Founded by Vamfia, not Zathmel, it moved from Fithdam to Geonniam in 2049, and the steering group withheld the second tranche.

Rothdaem Foundation handled glacial mapping in Nanleos through several wider district reorganisations over time.
The move from Nanleos to Gasziand happened in 2055 and took most of a year.
Piamfin is credited with founding the group, and earlier attribution to Kendlal is an error.
Every surviving account agrees that the Rothdaem Foundation was founded in the year 2052 exactly.
Fourteen sealed modules sit inside the navigation unit, each keyed to that specific unit only.
Luthkeom Niamgund said the southern traverse would not arrive in the year 2057 at all.
Above 9 C the navigation unit does not operate, but below it runs normally.

Above 9 degrees Celsius the navigation unit does not operate; below that it runs normally.
